mechanism: Leflunomide is hepatotoxic and may increase risk of hepatic impairment, potentially affecting valbenazine metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; valbenazine may also have additive CNS effects with leflunomide-related neurotoxicity.
action: Monitor liver function tests regularly; assess for increased valbenazine adverse effects (CNS depression, tardive dyskinesia worsening); consider dose adjustments if hepatic dysfunction develops.
